title: Site Reliability Engineering
description:
Quem somos?

Somos parceiros estratégicos de nossos clientes na jornada de transformação digital, oferecendo soluções inovadoras para a implementação de tecnologias em nuvem. Com o apoio do nosso time de especialistas, auxiliamos na migração para ambientes em nuvem, modernização de aplicações, segurança de dados, serviços gerenciados e práticas de FinOps eficientes.

Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, busca inovação e acredita no poder da colaboração, temos a oportunidade ideal para você como SRE do nosso time de Suporte e Sustentação!

O seu papel será:

  • Construir e evoluir ambientes em nuvem utilizando infraestrutura como código, garantindo que os projetos sigam padrões de arquitetura, governança, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Atuar na operação e sustentação de ambientes críticos, realizando análises profundas de disponibilidade, capacidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Implementar e manter métricas, dashboards e alertas de observabilidade
  • Atuar no atendimento de incidentes complexos, realizando diagnóstico avançado e implementando soluções definitivas.
  • Apoiar o time de pré-vendas na validação técnica de arquiteturas, esclarecimento de dúvidas e recomendações de melhorias.
  • Acompanhar clientes em reuniões recorrentes, apresentar relatórios técnicos e orientar decisões estratégicas relacionadas ao ambiente.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, analisando custos e propondo otimizações para aumentar eficiência e reduzir desperdícios.
  • Construir e aprimorar pipelines de automação e CI/CD, reduzindo intervenções manuais e aumentando a confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de segurança em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas homologadas, monitorando vulnerabilidades e propondo ações de mitigação.
  • Validar e homologar ferramentas técnicas utilizadas pela área, garantindo aderência às melhores práticas.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento com o time, apoiar analistas menos experientes e contribuir para melhoria contínua dos processos internos.

Para participar desse processo seletivo, você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prática como SRE, DevOps ou Especialista Cloud, atuando em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade.
  • Vivência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) em nível avançado.
  • Domínio de infraestrutura como código, especialmente Terraform.
  • Experiência com observabilidade, análise de métricas, logs e alertas.
  • Conhecimento em automação, pipelines de CI/CD e integração contínua.
  • Vivência com containers, microserviços, redes e administração de sistemas Linux.
  • Experiência em análise de performance, escalabilidade e estabilidade de sistemas distribuídos.
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver incidentes complexos com autonomia e clareza.
  • Comunicação clara para expressar ideias técnicas de forma objetiva e alinhada ao cliente.
  • Pensamento analítico para avaliar cenários com profundidade e tomar decisões baseadas em dados.
  • Proatividade para atuar preventivamente, antecipando problemas e propondo soluções.
  • Trabalho em equipe para colaborar com diferentes áreas e sustentar um ambiente de confiança e parceria.
  • Gestão do tempo para organizar prioridades e garantir entregas consistentes.

title: Wholesale Account Director
description:
About GTT:

GTT is a leading networking and security-as-a-service provider for multinational organizations, simply and securely connecting people and machines to data and applications – anywhere in the world. Built on our top-ranked global Tier 1 network, GTT Envision is a single global technology platform to connect, orchestrate, virtualize and automate enterprise networks. Our portfolio includes SASE, SD-WAN, security, internet, voice and other connectivity options, complemented by professional services and exceptional sales and support teams worldwide. We partner with our customers to deliver Greater Technology Together. Learn more at

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategies to penetrate Tier 1/2 carriers & ISPs
  • Sell GTT’s international network services, including Global WAN, Ethernet, Direct Internet Access, IP Transit, SD-WAN, and MPLS.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with wholesale partners and decision-making units with significant international footprints.
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities from a standing start and revive dormant accounts.
  • Present GTT’s value proposition to prospects and customers through compelling proposals and presentations.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from discovery through development to close, ensuring timely execution and deal completion.
  • Collaborate with marketing and internal teams to maximize prospecting initiatives and accelerate pipeline growth.
  • Candidates must speak, English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Required Experience/Qualifications:

The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of the LATAM wholesale carrier market, including the commercial landscape, pricing dynamics, and cross-border connectivity trends. Knowledge of major Tier 1 carriers and regional operators—such as Claro, Telefónica, América Móvil, and Millicom—is essential to identify opportunities and negotiate effectively. This expertise will enable the candidate to position GTT’s global network solutions competitively and drive strategic growth in the region.

  • 5–10+ years of experience in wholesale or reseller sales within the telecom or networking industry.
  • Proven track record of negotiating and closing deals with Tier 1 carriers, ISPs, and channel partners.
  • Strong knowledge of global WAN services, Ethernet, DIA, IP Transit, and related technologies.
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as SPIN, Miller Heiman, or similar.
  • Ability to engage confidently with technical topics and articulate complex solutions clearly.
  • Experience selling SD-WAN and security solutions.
  • Established network of contacts within the carrier and reseller ecosystem.

Core Competencies:

  • Negotiating
  • Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.
  • Networking
  • Understanding of the business value of creating mutually beneficial relationships with individuals outside of incumbent's own organization and ability to generate productive.
  • Sales Proposals and Presentations
  • Knowledge of sales processes, tools, and techniques; ability to prepare and present formal recommendations for how the organization can meet the customer's needs.
  • Value Selling
  • Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product/service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer need.
  • Customer First (Customer Facing)
  • Knowledge of customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting customer value creation at every level. Builds relationships with internal and external partners that improve access to resources and expertise.

EEO Statement:

GTT provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, GTT complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: Auxiliar de arquitetura
description:
Local de Trabalho: São Paulo/SP -

Jornada de Trabalho: Escala: Segunda a Sexta | Horário: 08:00 às 17:00 (200 horas mensais)

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos contratando profissionais para atuar como Auxiliar de Arquitetura em nossa empresa cliente, de grande porte, no setor de pesquisa e Desenvolvimento.

O profissional será responsável por apoiar as atividades do Departamento de Administração de Serviços, elaborando e atualizando plantas baixas, leiautes, gerenciando documentação técnica e administrativa relacionada a contratos e processos corporativos.

Atividades

  • Elaborar, atualizar e finalizar plantas baixas e leiautes dos ambientes do Instituto utilizando AutoCAD, SketchUp e Revit
  • Realizar levantamentos e medições de edificações com trena analógica e digital para posterior execução de projetos
  • Elaborar documentos de compras públicas (termo de referência, ofícios, memorandos, aditamentos contratuais) em conformidade com as Leis Federais nº 13.303/16 e nº 10.520/02
  • Apoiar na análise e revisão de normas e instruções normativas, bem como na administração de sistemas corporativos (ERP)

  • Planejar suprimento de materiais de consumo e serviços, emitindo solicitações internas, requisições de compras e prestação de contas
  • Atender e orientar as demais áreas da empresa quanto a procedimentos internos e documentações contratuais
  • Apoiar na gestão, fiscalização e execução de contratos, conferindo medições e certificando notas fiscais
  • Atualizar cadastros, digitalizar documentos e manter canais de comunicação interna atualizados
  • Atender requisições de órgãos de controle e auditorias internas/externas
  • Elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas de atividades e processos do Departamento

Requisitos

Essenciais:

Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Arquitetura, Engenharia Civil, Administração ou áreas correlatas às atividades

Experiência: Mínimo de 01 ano comprovado em acompanhamento e execução de contratos

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Domínio de AutoCAD, SketchUp e Revit
  • Excel avançado (fórmulas avançadas e tabelas dinâmicas)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas ERP
  • Legislação de licitações e contratos (Lei Federal nº 10.520/2002 e Lei Federal nº 13.303/2016)
  • Técnicas de redação comercial e administrativa
  • Operação de trena analógica e digital

Disponibilidade: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 08:00 às 17:00

Diferenciais (ou Desejáveis):

  • Experiência prévia em compras públicas e processos licitatórios
  • Vivência em instituições públicas ou de pesquisa
  • Conhecimento em gestão de contratos de prestação de serviços

Oferecemos

  • Salário Bruto CLT: R$ 3.667,30 (mensalista)
  • Refeitório com refeição fornecida no Local
  • Vale-Alimentação (R$163.83/mês)
  • incentivo Assuidade (R$100,00/mês)
  • Vale-transporte (desc. 6%)
  • Seguro de vida (sem custo)
  • Assistência odontológica (via sindicato SINDEEPRES)

Compromisso com a Diversidade e Inclusão

A BK Consultoria incentiva e valoriza a candidatura de todos os perfis profissionais, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho diverso e inclusivo. Respeitamos e celebramos as diferenças de religião, posicionamento político, idade, etnia, nacionalidade, origem social, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, pessoas com deficiência e demais grupos socialmente minorizados.

Nossa empresa mantém tolerância zero a qualquer forma de discriminação, preconceito, etarismo, LGBTfobia, capacitismo, racismo, xenofobia ou outras práticas discriminatórias. Acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece nossas equipes e contribui para um ambiente corporativo mais inovador e respeitoso.

title: Risk & Response Manager [Trust and Safety]
description:
This role is critical in managing escalations, mitigating risks, and protecting the integrity of our platform and community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage complex escalations from Customer Service and cross-functional teams, including copyright, advertising fraud, hate speech, minor safety, and underage accounts.
  • Handle inquiries and escalations from authorities, regulators, law enforcement, and court orders, ensuring compliance with Brazilian laws and internal policies.
  • Review and assess sensitive or harmful content with professionalism and discretion.
  • Identify emerging risks and harmful trends, sharing insights to improve policies and enforcement strategies.
  • Support and lead responses to major incidents (e.g., elections, disinformation campaigns, crisis events).
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure scalable and consistent risk response processes.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Policy, Product, Operations, Legal, Public Affairs) and represent the company in discussions with external stakeholders when required.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Political Science, International Relations, Communications, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience in Trust & Safety, Risk Response, Law Enforcement Response, Online Content Moderation, or similar roles.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazil’s digital and regulatory landscape, especially regarding online platforms, elections, and content risks.
  • Proven ability to manage sensitive escalations and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with experience drafting SOPs or operational playbooks.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and verbal).

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of global regulatory environments and risk trends.
  • Previous experience handling high-stakes incidents in online platforms or apps.
  • Mandarin is a plus.

  • Design and optimize the BI semantic layer to enable self-service analytics in Power BI.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable data architecture solutions.
  • Establish best practices for data modeling, pipeline development, and version control using GitHub.
  • Track project progress and deliverables through Jira.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the Project team.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Data Architect or Solution Architect with a strong background in cloud-based data platforms.

Required Skills

Perfil comportamental

  • Organização excepcional e atenção aos detalhes.

  • 100% remoto, contratação PJ.
  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado, com bônus de performance.

SOBRE A ALBUQUERQUE PAULO & ASSOCIADOS

Somos uma consultoria especializada em financiamentos incentivados para empresas de médio e grande porte. Atuamos na estruturação e condução de projetos complexos, com foco em operações diretas com o BNDES e demais instituições de fomento.

title: AML/CFT Compliance Expert
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance AML/CFT and sanctions policies in alignment with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Act as a primary compliance interface with regulators, including managing inspections, responding to inquiries, and executing remediation plans.
  • Perform risk-based customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews for both individuals and corporate clients.
  • Support ongoing monitoring activities, including transaction surveillance, sanctions screening, and the investigation of alerts or potentially suspicious behaviors.
  • Prepare, review, and submit Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other mandatory filings to COAF or relevant regulatory bodies.
  • Track legislative and regulatory developments related to AML/CFT and sanctions, and drive timely updates to internal policies and procedures.
  • Assist in delivering internal training programs to strengthen organizational awareness of AML/CFT and sanctions compliance obligations.
  • Conduct periodic AML/CFT risk assessments to validate control effectiveness and ensure alignment with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, audit trails, and recordkeeping for all compliance assessments, escalations, investigations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits as well as regulatory reviews, ensuring timely and accurate provision of information.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to enhance compliance systems, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and oversight of third-party service providers supporting AML/CFT and broader compliance functions.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience within financial services, fintech, or virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense , with sound judgment in escalation and decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of COAF, the Central Bank of Brazil, CVM regulations, and FATF recommendations.
  • Hands-on expertise in KYC/KYB processes, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or a related field; postgraduate studies or professional certifications (CAMS, ICA, etc.) strongly preferred.
  • Excellent analytical abilities, high ethical standards, and full professional fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must satisfy all fit-and-proper requirements, including:
  • No history of bankruptcy or insolvency;
  • An impeccable professional reputation;
  • Strong understanding of the crypto industry, including market dynamics and associated risks;
  • Technical competence aligned with the responsibilities of the role.

A Robert Half valoriza a diversidade e acredita que múltiplas perspectivas fortalecem pessoas, equipes e resultados.

Python. Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. DevOps e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.

  7. Team Development & Capability Building: Develop and organize systematic training and growth plans for team members, continuously identify and cultivate talents, and build a high-performing and cohesive team.
  8. Industry Trend Insights & Innovation: Stay updated on order-taking solution development in the restaurant/merchant industry, including APIs, hardware, and apps; drive innovation in integration solutions and lead the professional advancement of the team.

Job Requirements

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Computer Science, Information Management, E-commerce, or related fields.
  2. At least 3 years of experience in technical integration, system implementation, product operations, or related team management, with a preference for experience in large-scale API, hardware, or integrated solution project management.
  3. Strong technical solution analysis, design, and optimization abilities; able to systematically solve complex technical and business problems.
  4. Familiar with API interfaces, hardware products (such as printers), apps, and various integration methods; deep understanding of overall solutions for the merchant industry is a plus.
  5. Outstanding cross-team communication, coordination, and project management skills; able to drive collaboration and achieve project goals.
  6. Ability to organize team training and development, nurture talent, and build a high-performing team.
  7. Results-oriented, highly resilient, and self-driven, with awareness of process optimization and high-standard quality control.
  8. Native-level Portuguese and strong proficiency in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing); able to communicate efficiently in an international and diverse environment. 9.Experience in restaurant/merchant integration projects or industry solution operations is a plus.

Job Highlights

  1. Early-Stage Business: Opportunity to participate in early-stage planning, design, and implementation of team and projects, driving core technology and product innovation.

title: Vice President of Sales - LATAM
description:
About GTT

GTT is a leading networking and security as a service provider for multinational organizations, simply and securely connecting people and machines to data and applications – anywhere in the world. We serve thousands of organizations, bringing together the right people, partners and technology to reduce the burden on IT teams and solve the most pressing networking and security challenges. Built on our top-ranked global Tier 1 network, GTT Envision is a single global technology platform to connect, orchestrate, virtualize and automate enterprise networks, enabling customers with consumable solutions to achieve business missions and meet ongoing demand when, where and how needed. Our portfolio includes SASE, SD-WAN, security, internet, voice and other connectivity options, complemented by a suite of professional services and exceptional sales and support teams in local markets around the globe. We partner with our customers to deliver Greater Technology Together.

Role Summary

The VP, Sales - LATAM drives strategic market expansion for GTT by developing and nurturing high-value, long-term relationships with key Carrier, Wholesale, and Strategic Alliance partners across the Latin American region. This role focuses on ecosystem development , identifying and securing new business models, and creating sustainable revenue channels through partnerships, rather than direct transactional sales. The Manager will be responsible for defining and executing the strategic plan to significantly increase GTT's market presence and network reach in LATAM.

Job Scope and Stakeholder Engagement

This role serves as a strategic bridge between GTT's offerings and the LATAM carrier market.

  • External Focus: Primary interaction is with executive and strategic planning teams at Target Carrier Partners, Global Data Center Providers, and potential Channel Partners to establish commercial, network, and technology alliances.
  • Internal Collaboration: Works closely with Product, Strategy, Finance, and Legal to define partnership terms and new commercial models. Acts as the voice of the LATAM market to inform Sales Engineering and Network Planning on necessary infrastructure investments.

Duties And Responsibilities

This role's success is measured by strategic outcomes and long-term pipeline growth , not immediate sales quota achievement.

  • Market Strategy & Penetration: Develop and execute a comprehensive LATAM Carrier Business Development plan, identifying white-space opportunities, competitive threats, and potential strategic partners to secure GTT's long-term competitive advantage.
  • Partnership Identification and Structuring: Proactively identify, qualify, and negotiate strategic agreements with major LATAM carriers (e.g., IXPs, Mobile Operators, Regional Tier 1/2 Carriers) to expand GTT's network footprint and service portfolio in the region.
  • Ecosystem Development: Cultivate a robust network of strategic channel and alliance partners to drive scalable, indirect distribution of GTT services.
  • Long-Term Pipeline Generation: Establish a pipeline focused on multi-year revenue potential stemming from new partnerships, joint ventures, and wholesale capacity swaps, ensuring sustainable growth.
  • Cultural and Business Acumen: Leverage deep regional knowledge and fluency in local business practices to effectively structure and manage relationships across diverse LATAM territories.
  • Reporting: Track and report on market penetration, new partnership launches, pipeline value of strategic deals, and the successful commercialization of new routes/services.

Required Experience/Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in a Business Development, Partnership Management, or Strategic Alliance role within the global telecommunications/technology sector focusing on the LATAM carrier market.
  • Demonstrated Success in Ecosystem Building: A proven track record of successfully identifying, negotiating, and launching complex, non-standard commercial agreements (e.g., wholesale capacity swaps, joint GTM strategies, network peering).
  • Deep Regional Carrier Knowledge: Thorough understanding of the competitive landscape, regulatory environment, key contacts, and market trends across major LATAM countries.
  • Strategic & Financial Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts and financial modeling needed to assess partnership viability, structure favorable deals, and articulate the long-term return on investment (ROI).
  • Exceptional Communication & Negotiation: Superior ability to influence, communicate, and negotiate with executive-level stakeholders both internally and with external carrier partners.
  • Bilingual Proficiency: Fluency in Spanish and English is essential. Portuguese is a significant advantage, to effectively navigate business and cultural nuances in the region.
  • Networking and Relationship Capital: Existing strong relationships and a robust network within the executive and planning ranks of LATAM carrier accounts.
  • Ambition and Strategic Thinking: A proactive mindset focused on identifying and securing next-generation opportunities and expanding GTT's strategic positioning, not just fulfilling immediate demand.

Core Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  • Negotiating: Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.
  • Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Networking: Understanding of the business value of creating mutually beneficial relationships with individuals outside of incumbent's own organization and ability to generate productive relationships with internal and external partners that improve access to resources and expertise.
  • Channel Sales: Knowledge of various channel sales strategies and solutions used to execute and fulfil a sales plan; ability to sell a hospitality organization's brand, products, and services through multiple and diverse avenues
  • Sales Proposals and Presentations: Knowledge of sales processes, tools, and techniques; ability to prepare and present formal recommendations for how the organization can meet the customer's needs.
  • Value Selling: Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product/service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer needs.

Universal Competencies

  • Continuous Improvement: Knowledge of transformation initiatives to drive fundamental changes, enhance responsiveness and efficiency to core business practices. Ability to drive cultural changes from best effort to results oriented.
  • Customer First (Customer Facing) : Knowledge of internal customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting internal customer value creation at every level.
  • Operational Excellence: Understanding the system-driven processes for consistency and scalability. Ability to re-focus processes and systems from integration activity to maximizing a positive customer impact and anticipating future trends.

EEO statement

GTT provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, GTT complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

GTT expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of GTT’s employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Pleno I (PDV)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Atividades:

  • Atuar com sustentação dos sistemas de PDV (TOTVS e Casa Magalhães) com foco em suportar as operações de lojas físicas;
  • Atuar, identificar e solucionar problemas de conectividade em lojas, avaliando equipamentos e link;
  • Acionar parceiros de conectividade quando necessário para reestabelecer serviços
  • Atuar, identificar e solucionar problemas de hardware nos PDVs das lojas;
  • Responsável por tratar os incidentes, sendo de software ou infra, das lojas de forma rápida e eficiente, seguindo os padrões definidos pelos parceiros internos e externos;
  • Atuar de forma proativa em lojas que apresentem sintomas de problemas em sua jornada de vendas;
  • Interpretar gráficos de alertas, quando indicadores saem do limite aceitável;
  • Negociar, envolver e buscar a integração do trabalho junto ao time de atendimento N1, garantindo sinergia, apoio e formação;
  • Responsável em manter a base de conhecimento e de procedimentos técnicos atualizada;

Requisitos:

  • Experiência em trabalhar com metodologia (ITIL e Framework Scrum);
  • Conhecimento ferramentas de gestão de TI, JIRA, TFS e Service NOW;
  • Conhecimento básico em scripts em powershell.
  • Conhecimento avançado em comandos de administração de sistema operacional Microsoft através de PowerShell ou prompt de comando;
  • Conhecimento avançado para suporte remoto em celulares Android e computadores windows;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP e afins);
  • Troubleshooting em ambientes Microsoft Windows 7, Windows 10 e Windows 11.

Modelo 100% remoto.

title: Especialista Tecnico de Serviços I
description:
Sobre a Canon Medical:

A Canon Medical Systems do Brasil trabalha em ser referência na alta tecnologia em diagnóstico por imagem e oferecer soluções inovadoras que permitem melhorar o seu negócio e resultados dos pacientes.

Por mais de 100 anos, a Canon Medical tem estado na vanguarda da imagiologia diagnóstica, criando soluções de saúde que melhoram a vida das pessoas. Nós nos associamos com as principais instituições clínicas e acadêmicas ao redor do mundo para desenvolver sistemas e serviços que ultrapassam os limites da qualidade de imagem e eficiência de fluxo de trabalho.

Inspirados pela nossa filosofia "Made for Life" , estamos dedicados a fornecer soluções de saúde que abordem as necessidades e preocupações do mundo real de pacientes, profissionais médicos, clientes e parceiros.

Sobre a Vaga:

Execução de instalações, manutenções preventivas e corretivas de equipamentos médicos de diagnóstico por imagem comercializados pela empresa nos quais for habilitado, após treinamento e/ou sob acompanhamento de outros colaboradores habilitados previamente.

Ministrar treinamento de operações básicas de equipamentos médicos de diagnósticos por imagem. Estes treinamentos não envolvem pacientes e servem apenas para mostrar as funcionalidades básicas antes do treinamento conduzido pelo Especialista de Aplicação.

Instalar e configurar sistemas de pós processamento de imagens e sistema de suporte remoto.

Realizar o pedido de coleta de peças, enviadas para o atendimento técnico nos equipamentos.

Documentar todos os serviços realizados por meio da Ordem de Serviço, validando assim o atendimento técnico.

Executar atividades de recondicionamento de equipamentos comercializados pela empresa, assim como revisão de equipamentos de ultrassom que serão enviados para demonstração.

Conhecimentos em redes e informática.

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
About the job

1. About Us

We are a leading global technology company operating in the high-growth sector of On-Demand Consumer Services . Leveraging innovative technology and proven strategies from a global digital commerce leader, we are driving massive international expansion. We offer a challenging, fast-paced environment and an unparalleled opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up in new markets.

2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist our organization in establishing a local sales team , building from scratch to drive business expansion. Rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals through systematic one-on-one and group training models.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth internal and external communication channels. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.

3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience : Proven experience in managing sales teams , with outstanding performance in a high-growth company over the past years.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between global headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work.

4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of a global digital giant's international business expansion and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

description:
NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.

Remuneração Variável

title: Propulsion Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage in close collaboration with stakeholders from various teams to gather in-depth insights into the requirements and objectives of the vehicle. Work closely with cross-functional teams, including electrical and software engineers to ensure seamless integration of the propulsion systems.
  • Propulsion System Development: Apply advanced engineering principles and methodologies to create propulsion solutions that are recognized for their reliability, efficiency, and high performance. Take the lead in chairing meetings with stakeholders, actively listen to their concerns, facilitate productive discussions, and collaborate towards resolving any issues collectively. Additionally, prepare and deliver comprehensive presentations to the leadership team, highlighting the significant progress and achievements attained during the propulsion system development process.
  • Network and Electrical Drawings: Leverage your technical proficiency and attention to detail to generate accurate and comprehensive communication and System Electrical Drawings for all vehicles and all phases like mules, protos, production etc. These deliverables will serve as essential references throughout the engineering process, facilitating effective communication, troubleshooting, and maintenance of the propulsion systems.

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, or any other related field.
  • Minimum 5-8 years of experience in Electrical/Electronics/Automotive field
  • Strong understanding of engineering cost and time implications.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, enabling effective interaction with stakeholders across different teams.
  • In-depth knowledge of engineering principles.
  • Analytic mindset and problem-solving abilities to address complex engineering challenges.
  • Passion for innovation and drive to contribute to cutting-edge projects in automotive industry.
  • Familiar with the Agile-Scrum methodology and the associated concepts of planning
  • Sound knowledge of CAN and LIN components (HW/SW)
  • Capable of creating Logical as well as Physical Schematics
  • Experience with Microsoft Visio, Excel, Word and Power Point
  • Highly motivated/self starter with proven leadership skills

title: Cross-border Customs Operations
description:
Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Responsibilities:

1. Manage and oversee the logistics and customs clearance processes of platform products from China to Brazil, ensuring compliance with Brazilian laws and regulations.

2. Coordinate relationships with Brazilian customs, logistics providers, and government agencies to enhance clearance quality and efficiency.

3. Track changes in customs policies and regulations in the Brazilian market to ensure compliance and forward-thinking business operations.

4. Address issues in cross-border e-commerce clearance operations such as inspections, timeliness, customer complaints, and key processes.

5. Develop and execute strategies to optimize tariffs and logistics costs, improving AliExpress's competitiveness in the Brazilian market.

6. Provide training in cross-border customs matters to enhance the professional capabilities of team members.

Localização: São Paulo, Brasil

Responsabilidades:

1. Gerir e supervisionar os processos logísticos e de desalfandegamento de produtos da plataforma da China para o Brasil, garantindo conformidade com as leis e regulamentos brasileiros.

2. Coordenar relações com a alfândega brasileira, fornecedores logísticos e agências governamentais para melhorar a qualidade e eficiência do desalfandegamento.

3. Acompanhar as mudanças nas políticas e regulamentos aduaneiros no mercado brasileiro para assegurar a conformidade e operações comerciais com visão de futuro.

4. Resolver problemas na operação de desalfandegamento do comércio eletrônico transfronteiriço como inspeções, prazos, reclamações de clientes e processos chave.

5. Desenvolver e executar estratégias para otimizar tarifas e custos logísticos, aumentando a competitividade do AliExpress no mercado brasileiro.

6. Oferecer treinamento em assuntos aduaneiros transfronteiriços para melhorar as capacidades profissionais dos membros da equipe.

Requirements:

1. Education: Bachelor's degree or above in international trade, logistics management, e-commerce, or related fields.

2. Experience:

◦ At least 3 years of experience in cross-border e-commerce and customs management.

◦ Experience operating e-commerce platforms in Brazil preferred.

3. Skills:

◦ Familiar with and proficient in customs processes between Brazil and China, and platform operation standards.

◦ Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of negotiating in various complex situations.

◦ Strong analytical skills for problem location and project management; ability to proactively optimize and implement solutions.

◦ Proficient in using relevant customs management software and e-commerce platform tools.

4. Language:

◦ Fluent in Portuguese with excellent written and spoken capabilities.

◦ Fluent in English; Mandarin skills preferred.

5. Other Requirements:

◦ Strong sense of responsibility and attention to business details.

◦ Adapt to rapidly changing international e-commerce environment and actively promote ongoing business development.

Requisitos:

1. Educação: Bacharelado ou superior em comércio internacional, gestão logística, comércio eletrônico ou áreas afins.

2. Experiência:

◦ Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em comércio eletrônico transfronteiriço e gestão aduaneira.

◦ Experiência operando plataformas de comércio eletrônico no Brasil preferida.

3. Habilidades:

◦ Familiaridade e proficiência nos processos aduaneiros entre Brasil e China, e normas de operação de plataforma.

◦ Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação, capaz de negociar em várias situações complexas.

◦ Fortes habilidades analíticas para localização de problemas e gerenciamento de projetos; capacidade de otimizar e implementar soluções proativamente.

◦ Proficiente em usar software de gestão aduaneira relevante e ferramentas de plataforma de comércio eletrônico.

4. Idioma:

◦ Fluente em português, com excelentes habilidades de escrita e fala.

◦ Fluente em inglês; habilidades em mandarim são preferidas.

5. Outros Requisitos:

◦ Forte senso de responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes do negócio.

◦ Adaptar-se a um ambiente de comércio eletrônico internacional em rápida mudança e promover ativamente o desenvolvimento contínuo dos negócios.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

description:

title: Commercial Account Manager
description:

Sales and Revenue:

  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Drive client retention, renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.
  • Negotiate and close deals effectively.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification to contract negotiation and customer onboarding.
  • Contribute to the development of sales strategies and best practices.
  • Gather market intelligence, developments, and competitor activities and share insights with the sales team.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Proven track record of success in a sales role, preferably in the software industry.
  • Experience with long sales cycles, request for proposals, and public tenders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience with open source software, API management, and IAM technologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and other sales tools.
  • Native portuguese speaker, fluent in English (oral and written).
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.
  • An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
  • An opportunity for professional growth and development.
  • A fully remote position with frequent short travel.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. title: Customer Success Intern
description:

title: Analista de Meio Ambiente Sr (Industrial Madeiras)
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Participar no processo de adequação de riscos ambientais especialmente no que se refere à gestão de resíduos sólidos, emissão de efluentes líquidos e gasosos, análises de solo e água subterrânea, dentre outros, a fim de mantê-los dentro dos padrões legais;
  • Acompanhar o controle das licenças e/ou autorizações ambientais, bem como, o desenvolvimento dos monitoramentos de medições, visando o atendimento da legislação pertinente e de inspeções e auditorias por órgãos credenciados e certificadores;
  • Controlar e avaliar os resultados de emissões gasosas, bem como, acompanhar o desenvolvimento de projetos que busquem melhorias e/ou otimização de custos em face que questões ambientais das unidades;
  • Participar de reuniões com autoridades e órgãos ambientais (Prefeitos, Secretários, FEPAM) nos assuntos referentes ao Meio Ambiente;
  • Planejar e elaborar controle de custos de destinação ou reciclagem de resíduos sólidos, em todas as fases do processo produtivo;
  • Fazer gestão e monitorar as ações relacionadas dos impactos das comunidades adjacentes às operações das unidades referente as questões ambientais;
  • Analisar e acompanhar os custos da área ambiental, elaborando a previsão de custos anuais e budget, bem como, acompanhando eventuais novas licitações de contratações;
  • Viabilizar a implementação e manutenção dos sistemas de gestão integrada definidos pela Empresa, promovendo sua divulgação, bem como, estabelecer ações que promovam a melhoria contínua e manutenção das rotinas necessárias de meio ambiente;
  • Apoiar na manutenção da certificação FSC Cadeira de Custódia (multi-site), mantendo os procedimentos documentados e comunicados para todos os sites participantes, bem como capacitar partes interessadas, planejando e executando auditorias internas e externas e assegurando o devido controle dos créditos.

Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência em Gestão Ambiental Industrial;
  • Formação Superior em Engenharia Ambiental, Química, Biologia, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de legislação ambiental, licenciamento e contato com a FEPAM;
  • Experiência com gestão de resíduos industriais;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Habilidade com sistemas de gestão ambiental;
  • Desejável vivência com FSC - Cadeia de custódia e Especialização em meio ambiente.

description:

description:
Auxiliar Odontológica

Realizar impressão da agenda do dia seguinte afim, de fazer um levantamento dos procedimentos a serem enviados ao laboratório;

Efetuar baixa no sistema de gestão ﻿ referente aos materiais recebidos do laboratório;

Realizar controle de prontuários na clínica;

Colocar os prontuários do dia sobre a bancada por ordem de atendimento;

Atenção ao paciente

Realizar o acolhimento do paciente nos serviços de saúde bucal;

Preparar o paciente para o atendimento;

Fazer checklist para realizar a separação dos materiais e instrumentos clínicos a serem utilizados pelo dentista nas cirurgias;

Auxiliar e instrumentar os profissionais nas intervenções clínicas;

Organizar os consultórios diariamente verificando se os materiais e ambientes estão de acordo para atender os pacientes;

Executar limpeza, assepsia, desinfecção e esterilização do instrumental, equipamentos odontológicos e do ambiente de trabalho;

Abastecer sempre os consultórios com os materiais do dia-a-dia sugador, resina, babador, entre outros;

Zelar pela boa manutenção de aparelhos e peças;

Aplicar medidas de biossegurança no armazenamento, transporte, manuseio e descarte de produtos e resíduos odontológicos;

Manipular materiais de uso odontológicos zelando para que o estoque esteja sempre abastecido;

Realizar controle de componentes de prótese e implantes;

Adotar medidas de biossegurança visando controle de contaminação.

Determinações Internas Utilizar uniforme e crachá adequadamente, mantendo sua apresentação pessoal e da empresa;

Utilizar corretamente os EPI's recomendados para a realização segura das tarefas de trabalho conforme os procedimentos relacionados à atividade exercida;

Cumprir as determinações que constam no Modelo de Negócio da Franqueadora.

Formação Escolaridade: Técnico de Saúde Bucal ou Auxiliar Odontológico e possuir registro no CRO.

Conhecimentos: Assepsia e Antissepsia;

Assepsia:

É o conjunto de medidas para evitar a contaminação de um ambiente ou material por microrganismos. 

Antissepsia:

É o uso de substâncias (antissépticos) para reduzir ou eliminar microrganismos em tecidos vivos, como pele e mucosas. 

Conhecimento do instrumental e materiais utilizados no atendimento clínico;

Experiência anterior: Auxiliar de Dentista, Auxiliar Odontológico.

MANUAL DE RECURSOS HUMANOS

Dinamismo: Atender pacientes de maneira dinâmica e clara, ser dinâmico é conseguir agregar a capacidade de raciocínio rápido e ser ágil no atendimento.

Simpatia: Fator crucial no atendimento para fidelizar nosso paciente a sua imagem é de extrema importância ela está atrelada a imagem da empresa, então ser simpática é um ponto positivo todos gostam de ser bem tratados.

title: Business Development Executive in Global Running Company - part-time with room to grow into full time
description:
Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven , team player , high performer , etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Business Development Executive with Go! Running Tours.

Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one!

So let's start.

Our new Business Development Executive will be responsible for our hotel market in the US, Asia and South America. It is an area that we have not focused on in the past, but we have had ad hoc partnerships with various hotels and in various forms, and the time has come to truly focus and succeed in this market. I am looking for a Business Developer who is ready to fully own and grow this market for us. It is a market with huge potential and with great interest in our running tours, and hotels we are currently working with include Mandarin, Hilton, and Marriott.

You should be someone who gets super motivated by the fact that there is no straightforward playbook, but instead a lot of building blocks we need to put together to make the perfect Tetris game. When we have this, the world is your oyster, because what works in one hotel will likely be a success in another, and hotel managers talk. And here comes the true superpower of what you are selling. While there are many local running tour providers in each city, Go! Running Tours is the only global player. So when the global hotel chains start eyeing your success with a few of their hotels, you'll be able to enter into a global partnership. And that is really what we are aiming for!

Our new colleague should believe in email outreach. It is our main channel of business generation, and while we don't do stone-cold emailing, we have had success with lukewarm and hot emailing in other markets in the past. You will be responsible for the campaigns and everything that goes with it in terms of crafting messages, building contact lists, and data work. I personally love spreadsheet work and get a kick out of using data extra smart, and if you enjoy that as well, you will thoroughly enjoy this part of the role.

It is very important for me that you have the drive and passion to always reach higher. I am not looking for someone to simply do a routine job and be content when we start closing business. I want someone who is continuously energised by doing more, making progress, and growing and scaling. You should be constantly looking for new and better ways of doing things, testing initiatives, and learning new tech/solutions. We are counting on you to make this a global success (the first of its kind)! Drive and diligence are superpowers in this role!

But it is not all rosy. It can be a challenge for hotels to prioritise the implementation of Go! Running Tours into their services. It is frustrating when we are just about to sign a contract and then our contact moves jobs

title: Bolsista Doutor - Grupo Boticário - SkinAge Brasil | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

O desafio propõe aprofundar o entendimento sobre a longevidade da pele e os efeitos do envelhecimento acelerado na população brasileira, considerando sua diversidade étnica, climática e ambiental. A iniciativa busca revelar como fatores intrínsecos e extrínsecos atuam na estrutura, função e vitalidade da pele ao longo das diferentes fases da vida.

O foco é gerar conhecimento científico proprietário, investigando mecanismos moleculares e celulares, e desenvolvendo métodos robustos para avaliar e compreender o impacto de agentes como radiação UV, poluição e estresse oxidativo. Esse conhecimento será a base para criar soluções cosméticas inovadoras, seguras e eficazes.

O tema contribui diretamente para fortalecer a vanguarda científica do Grupo Boticário, permitindo o desenvolvimento de produtos que promovam saúde, longevidade e cuidado integral, alinhados às necessidades reais da pele brasileira.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado em área correlata (Ciências Biológicas, Farmácia, Química, Engenharia Química, ou áreas afins)

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Longevidade e impactos do envelhecimento acelerado na pele da população brasileira.

Principais Atividades:

  • Habilidades de pesquisa: Metodologia científica: Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas científicas, desde o planejamento e execução de experimentos até a análise de dados e interpretação de resultados.
  • Técnicas de laboratório: Experiência em técnicas de biologia molecular, bioquímica, cultura de células, análise de imagem, ou outras técnicas relevantes para pesquisa de pele.
  • Análise de dados: Habilidade em análise estatística e bioestatística, utilizando softwares específicos (ex: GraphPad Prism, SPSS).
  • Busca bibliográfica: Capacidade de realizar buscas bibliográficas em bases de dados científicas (PubMed, Scopus, etc.) e revisar a literatura relevante.
  • Escrita científica: Habilidade em redigir relatórios, artigos científicos e apresentações de alta qualidade.
  • Habilidades de desenvolvimento de produtos e protótipos: Capacidade de criar e testar protótipos de produtos cosméticos, considerando as necessidades do mercado e as demandas dos consumidores.
  • Conhecimento regulatório: Familiaridade com as regulamentações sanitárias (ANVISA) e as normas de segurança para produtos cosméticos.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Fisiologia da pele: Profundo conhecimento da estrutura, função e metabolismo da pele, incluindo processos de envelhecimento cutâneo, regeneração e cicatrização.
  • Envelhecimento cutâneo: Domínio dos mecanismos moleculares e celulares do envelhecimento intrínseco e extrínseco da pele, incluindo o impacto de fatores ambientais (radiação UV, poluição, etc.).
  • Ingredientes cosméticos: Familiaridade com diferentes classes de ingredientes ativos e excipientes, incluindo suas propriedades, mecanismos de ação, segurança e eficácia.
  • Formulações cosméticas: Conhecimento prático de técnicas de formulação, estabilidade e otimização de produtos cosméticos

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Análise de dados: Habilidade em análise estatística e bioestatística, utilizando softwares específicos (ex: GraphPad Prism, SPSS).

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Híbrida

Idioma : Inglês.

Local: São José dos Pinhais/PR

Soft Skills : Autogestão, Trabalho em equipe, Pensamento Crítico, Autonomia.

title: Platform Architect
description:
Role Summary

The Platform Architect will serve as the technical “north star” for the design, integration, and evolution of the NexusOne data platform for customer deployments and large programs.

This individual will architect the platform, define integration points, and design scalable, secure solutions based on incoming enterprise requirements using the NexusOne platform. They will participate in architecture review boards and ensure that all implementations align with NexusOne’s composable, open-source design principles. This role is forward-facing and requires a customer-centric mentality.

Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and evolve the end-to-end NexusOne platform across on-prem, hybrid, and cloud environments based on customer requirements and limitations.
  • Design and designate integration points for data services, pipelines, orchestration, governance, and security layers.
  • Translate solution requests and business requirements into scalable, compliant architecture blueprints.
  • Lead and participate in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs) to align deployments with enterprise standards.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and integration frameworks .
  • Guide platform engineers and client teams in implementing best practices for security, observability, and reliability.
  • Oversee the selection, integration, and tuning of open-source components such as Airflow, Spark, Trino, YuniKorn, Superset, S3, NiFi, Ranger, and DataHub.
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to evolve the NexusOne “North Star” architecture and roadmap.
  • Mentor engineers and collaborate with DevOps, Security, and DataOps to drive alignment and platform maturity.

Must-Have Core Skills

  • Core Expertise: Spark, Trino, Airflow, NiFi, YuniKorn, Superset, Iceberg, Ranger, DataHub, S3.
  • Infrastructure & Automation: Terraform, Kubernetes (K8s), OpenShift (OCP), Docker, Linux.
  • Security & Governance: IAM, SSO, KMS, Kerberos, Encryption, RBAC.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus.
  • Programming: Java, Scala, Python (preferred).
  • Architecture Practices: Solution design, reference architectures, system modeling, scaling patterns.

Ideal Background

  • 8–12 years of experience designing or implementing large-scale distributed data platforms in regulated industries.
  • Proven track record as a technical architect or lead engineer at Cloudera, Databricks, AWS EMR, or similar open-source platform providers.
  • Hands-on experience integrating and operating open-source data tools across hybrid-cloud and containerized environments.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise governance and security frameworks (SOX, FFIEC, GDPR).
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills to influence architecture decisions across engineering and client teams.

Success Criteria

  • Delivery of a validated, production-ready platform architecture that meets client requirements.
  • Positive approval outcomes from Architecture Review Boards and internal security/governance reviews.
  • Defined and documented integration standards adopted by all implementation teams.
  • Successful enablement of platform engineers and developers through patterns, templates, and technical guidance.
  • Measurable reduction in deployment friction, downtime, or rework during environment rollouts.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.

Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.

  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.

  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.

Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus

  • applications

  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload

  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload

Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineers

Breakthrough Talent is currently supporting a leading data business build a brand new data platform to support a modern data mesh organisation. They work with national and global clients across data, software and digital consulting, and they are now looking for a Data Infrastructure Engineer to help build and scale their next generation platform.

This role suits someone who enjoys owning infrastructure, building reusable solutions, and supporting data teams with analytics and AI ready environments.

The Role

As a Data Engineer you will design, build and maintain the core infrastructure that enables data processing, analytics, data science and data management across the business.

You will work in a multi account and multi region AWS environment that follows zero trust and least privilege principles. Infrastructure as Code and CI CD will be central to how you operate, alongside continuous improvement and strong governance.

What You Will Do

  • Build and maintain cloud based infrastructure using Cloud Formation and SAM
  • Design and implement data processing environments using AWS services such as Glue, EMR, Sagemaker, Redshift, Aurora and Snowflake
  • Build data processing pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, Spark, Lambda, Step Functions and Apache Airflow
  • Monitor performance, cost and security of the data platform
  • Apply strong data governance and access control for sensitive data
  • Collaborate with multiple teams to support the wider data platform strategy

What You Need

  • Six years or more experience in a Data Engineering or Data Infrastructure role
  • Strong experience building data architectures in AWS
  • Solid coding skills in Python and SQL, Golang
  • Strong Cloud Formation knowledge
  • Experience working with relational databases such as Postgres or Redshift
  • Good coding discipline including documentation, unit testing and version control
  • Experience with Git and CI CD tools such as GitLab
  • Worked in Agile teams and ceremonies
  • Strong problem solving skills and excellent communication

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Jira or similar project management tools
  • Experience with Snowflake
  • Spatial data processing experience

If you would like to learn more about the role, please reach out to Jake Denman at Breakthrough Talent.

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Business Travel Consultant – Sabre Specialist

We are hiring on a rolling basis. Please apply ASAP if interested.

Open to candidates from all LATAM countries.

Company Overview

Our client is a U.S.-based high-end travel concierge agency specializing in luxury, business, and first-class travel experiences. They support global executives, VIP travelers, and corporate clients who require fast, precise, and concierge-level travel management.

As the company grows, we are seeking an experienced Business Travel Consultant with strong Sabre expertise to join the team and support daily travel operations.

Position Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled Business Travel Consultant who is expert-level in Sabre (GDS) and experienced in managing corporate or VIP travel arrangements.

This is not a sales role — it is a travel operations and internal support position, focused on booking, reissuing, revalidating, and managing complex itineraries.

The ideal candidate must be confident, accurate, calm under pressure, and deeply familiar with Sabre functionalities.

Key Responsibilities

Sabre Operations

  • Create, modify, and manage PNRs using Sabre Red 360.
  • Issue, reissue, and exchange tickets (including voluntary & involuntary changes).
  • Handle schedule changes, cancellations, fare differences, and endorsement procedures.
  • Review and interpret fare rules (FQD/FQR) and apply correct booking codes.
  • Perform queue management, seat assignments, SSR/OSI updates, and split PNRs.

Travel Coordination

  • Research and book complete itineraries: flights, hotels, cars (using GDS or partner platforms).
  • Provide high-touch support for VIP and executive clients.
  • Resolve urgent travel disruptions (missed flights, overbookings, irregular operations).
  • Coordinate with airlines, hotel partners, and internal teams to resolve issues promptly.

Client Support & Communication

  • Communicate itinerary details clearly and professionally.
  • Provide status updates and proactive solutions during travel disruptions.
  • Maintain accurate records of bookings, client preferences, and travel history.

Administration & Tools

  • Manage bookings through CRM or ERP tools (Salesforce experience is a plus).
  • Create confirmations, summaries, reports, and invoice-related documentation.
  • Keep internal systems updated with client and booking data.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience using Sabre (GDS) in daily operations.

Proven ability to:

  • Issue/reissue tickets
  • Manage exchanges
  • Interpret fare rules
  • Handle involuntary changes
  • Manage queues and PNR corrections
  • Strong background in corporate, executive, or VIP travel management.
  • Experience working for airlines, TMCs, or corporate travel departments.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • High attention to detail and strong problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work under pressure and handle time-sensitive requests.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with other GDS systems (Amadeus, Galileo).
  • Background in luxury travel or high-touch concierge service.
  • Experience supporting C-suite or international travelers.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM/ERP platforms.

Work Schedule

Full-time (~40 hours per week, PST or EST hours, with PST preferred as the company is located in PST hours)

Compensation

Payment available in USD or local currency, depending on candidate preference.
